items.zh: 我手机没电了，你有充电宝吗？
items.scene: 地铁上手机快关机，向同事借充电宝

answers.en: My phone's dead. Do you have a power bank?
answers.note: 最直接，先报手机没电再问对方有没有，dead 很口语，适合关系熟的同事。

answers.en: I'm out of juice — could I borrow a power bank?
answers.note: out of juice 指没电，could I borrow 比 Do you have 客气，适合不太熟的人。

answers.en: My phone just died on me. Got a power bank I could use?
answers.note: died on me 带无奈，Got... 省略句最随意，适合朋友间开口，不如上一句客气。

items.zh: 你手机还有电吗？帮我叫个车。
items.scene: 聚餐散场，朋友手机还有电，自己快关机

answers.en: Is your phone still alive? Can you get me a ride?
answers.note: alive 把手机拟人化，语气轻松，适合朋友之间，先确认电量再请对方叫车。

answers.en: Do you have any battery left? Could you book me a ride?
answers.note: battery left 中性，could you 礼貌，比上一句少一点玩笑味，适合关系一般的人。

answers.en: My phone's dead — can I use yours to book a ride?
answers.note: 先说明自己手机没电，再借手机自己操作，请求具体，比直接让对方代叫更省事。

items.zh: 充电器借我用一下，我充十分钟就走。
items.scene: 办公室手机快没电，跟邻座同事借充电器

answers.en: Can I borrow your charger for ten minutes? I'll be out of here after that.
answers.note: 直接说借十分钟并保证很快走，语气干脆，适合工位上顺口开口，客套最少。

answers.en: Mind if I plug in for ten minutes? My phone's about to die.
answers.note: Mind if 把请求包得客气，plug in 指插电，适合不太熟或对方正忙时。

answers.en: Could I use your charger real quick? I just need enough to get home.
answers.note: real quick 很口语，补一句只充到能回家，请求最轻，适合怕麻烦别人时。

items.zh: 插座在哪？我手机只剩百分之一了。
items.scene: 高铁上手机快关机，问乘务员插座位置

answers.en: Where's the outlet? My phone's at one percent.
answers.note: outlet 是美式说法，短句直接，适合已经看到乘务员、只想赶紧问位置时。

answers.en: Is there an outlet I can use? I'm down to one percent.
answers.note: 先问有没有可用的插座，语气客气；down to one percent 强调电量见底，适合不赶时间时。

answers.en: Sorry, where can I plug in? My phone's about to shut off.
answers.note: 先道歉再问，plug in 比 outlet 随口，about to shut off 说明马上关机，带点着急。

items.zh: 这个月流量又超了，你那边还有剩吗？
items.scene: 月底和室友出门，想蹭热点查路线

answers.en: I went over my data again this month — do you have any left?
answers.note: went over my data 是超出流量的日常说法，先自嘲再问，语气随口，适合朋友。

answers.en: I've used up my data for the month. Do you still have some?
answers.note: used up 强调已用光，问 still have 较中性，不直接提借，适合不想欠人情时。

answers.en: My data's maxed out again. Mind if I use your hotspot?
answers.note: maxed out 带无奈，直接提开热点，请求明确，比上一句主动，适合关系近的人。

items.zh: 你套餐里多少流量？够刷视频吗？
items.scene: 朋友准备换手机套餐，问你用得怎么样

answers.en: How much data is in your plan? Is it enough for streaming?
answers.note: 问套餐含多少流量，streaming 偏具体，适合想了解刷视频体验，语气中性。

answers.en: How much data do you get? Can you watch videos on it?
answers.note: get 是问套餐额度的口语动词，watch videos 更直白，比上一句少技术味。

answers.en: Does your plan have enough data for videos, or do you run out every month?
answers.note: 用一般疑问句确认够不够，run out 点出月底用光的担心，像帮对方分析，建议味最重。

items.zh: 你家 Wi-Fi 密码是多少？
items.scene: 第一次去朋友家，坐下后想连网

answers.en: What's your Wi-Fi password?
answers.note: 最短最直接，在朋友家随口问很自然，客套最少，适合关系熟的人。

answers.en: Could I get the Wi-Fi password?
answers.note: Could I get 把询问变成请求，比上一句客气，适合第一次上门或对方长辈在场。

answers.en: What's the Wi-Fi password here? I need to check something.
answers.note: 加 here 明确问当前网络，补一句要查消息，让请求有来由，比上一句随意。

items.zh: Wi-Fi 又断了，你那边能连上吗？
items.scene: 在家开视频会突然掉线，问室友

answers.en: The Wi-Fi dropped again. Can you get online?
answers.note: dropped 指连接突然中断，先报情况再确认对方，语气平实，适合边处理工作边说。

answers.en: My Wi-Fi cut out again — is yours working?
answers.note: cut out 偏口语，is yours working 用来判断是路由器还是整栋楼的问题，比上一句随意。

answers.en: The internet just went out on me again. Are you connected?
answers.note: went out on me 带明显烦躁，connected 稍技术，适合正开视频会、忍不住抱怨时。

items.zh: 路由器是不是该换了？隔一堵墙就没信号。
items.scene: 跟家人说卧室 Wi-Fi 老断

answers.en: Should we get a new router? The signal dies as soon as I'm in the bedroom.
answers.note: Should we 是商量口吻，signal dies 很形象，适合家人一起决定，语气中性。

answers.en: Maybe it's time for a new router — the Wi-Fi barely reaches the bedroom.
answers.note: Maybe it's time 语气缓和，barely reaches 强调覆盖差，比上一句少一点催促。

answers.en: Do you think the router's the problem? I lose signal the minute I go into my room.
answers.note: 先问路由器是不是问题，再给具体现象，偏分析，适合还没拿定主意、想先排查。

items.zh: 手机怎么这么卡？是不是该清一下了？
items.scene: 点开微信都要转圈，跟朋友抱怨手机

answers.en: Why is my phone so slow? Do I need to clean it up?
answers.note: slow 最通用，clean it up 指清理手机，像顺口问建议，抱怨最轻。

answers.en: My phone's been lagging like crazy. Should I clear some stuff out?
answers.note: lagging like crazy 很口语，clear some stuff out 指删东西腾空间，比上一句情绪重。

answers.en: Is it just me, or is this phone getting really sluggish? Maybe I should free up some space.
answers.note: Is it just me 带自嘲，sluggish 比 slow 书面，整句像自言自语，适合不确定是否普遍时。

items.zh: 你手机开这么多后台，不卡吗？
items.scene: 看到朋友手机开了几十个应用，随口问

answers.en: You've got so many apps open — doesn't your phone lag?
answers.note: 直接指出应用开得多再问卡不卡，像朋友提醒，语气中性，不带批评。

answers.en: Aren't you worried about lag with all those apps running?
answers.note: Aren't you worried 带惊讶和关心，比上一句多一层替对方操心，适合关系不错时。

answers.en: With that many apps open, how is your phone not freezing?
answers.note: 反问句带夸张，freezing 指卡死，玩笑味最重，只适合能互相打趣的朋友。

items.zh: 我手机内存满了，照片都存不下了。
items.scene: 旅行途中拍照，手机提示存储空间不足

answers.en: My phone's storage is full — I can't even save photos anymore.
answers.note: storage 是美式常用说法，陈述事实加结果，语气平实，适合跟同行人说明情况。

answers.en: I'm out of storage on my phone. I can't take any more pictures.
answers.note: out of storage 强调空间用尽，take pictures 比 save photos 口语，适合边拍边说。

answers.en: My phone's completely full. There's no room left for photos.
answers.note: completely full 加重无奈，no room left 很形象，抱怨味最重，适合旅途中着急时。

items.zh: 你手机多大内存的？我想买个同款。
items.scene: 在手机店体验样机，问旁边顾客机型

answers.en: How much storage does your phone have? I'm thinking of getting the same one.
answers.note: storage 问得准确，thinking of 表示还在考虑，不像销售逼问，适合正规店里打听。

answers.en: What size is your phone? I want to get the same model.
answers.note: What size 是日常问法，可能指容量或尺寸，靠 model 补清楚，比上一句含糊。

answers.en: How many gigs is yours? I'm looking at the same phone.
answers.note: gigs 是 gigabyte 的口语说法，最随意，适合年轻人之间快速打听，不适合正式场合。

items.zh: 系统更新完怎么变这样了？
items.scene: 手机更新后图标和设置都变了，问同事

answers.en: Why does my phone look like this after the update?
answers.note: Why does... 直接表达困惑和不满，look like this 指界面变样，适合刚更新完吐槽。

answers.en: Did the update change everything on your phone too?
answers.note: Did...too 用来找同机型的人确认，带惊讶，比上一句少责怪系统，适合办公室随口问。

answers.en: My phone's completely different after the update — is yours like this?
answers.note: 先陈述变化再问对方，different 中性，带求证意味，语气比上一句缓。

items.zh: 先别更新，听说新系统特别耗电。
items.scene: 室友准备点系统更新，你提醒他再等等

answers.en: Hold off on the update — I heard the new system drains your battery.
answers.note: Hold off 叫对方先缓一缓，drains your battery 说明耗电，像提醒，语气中肯。

answers.en: Don't update yet. People say the new version eats battery.
answers.note: Don't update yet 最直接，eats battery 很口语，适合关系近、说话不绕弯的人。

answers.en: Maybe wait on that update. The new OS is supposed to be a battery killer.
answers.note: Maybe wait 语气软，battery killer 带夸张，像转述网上评价，适合劝人别急着更新。

items.zh: 我手机死机了，怎么按都没反应。
items.scene: 手机突然黑屏卡住，问旁边的人怎么办

answers.en: My phone's frozen. Nothing I press works.
answers.note: frozen 指画面卡住不动，Nothing I press 强调按什么都没用，陈述直接，适合先说明情况。

answers.en: My phone just crashed — it won't respond to anything.
answers.note: crashed 偏指系统突然崩溃，won't respond 较通用，语气着急，适合问身边人怎么办。

answers.en: My screen's completely stuck. I've tried everything and it won't budge.
answers.note: stuck 强调卡死，won't budge 把手机当犟东西说，烦躁最明显，适合熟人之间抱怨。

items.zh: 得强制重启吧？长按电源键试试。
items.scene: 同事手机卡死，你在旁边帮着出主意

answers.en: You might need to force a restart. Try holding the power button.
answers.note: might need to 是推测式建议，不把话说死，适合在旁边帮同事判断。

answers.en: Try holding the power button — that should force a restart.
answers.note: 先给动作再说预期结果，语气笃定，像自己遇到过，比上一句有把握。

answers.en: Just hold the power button until it restarts.
answers.note: Just 加祈使句最干脆，省掉解释，适合对方已经急得不想听长句时。

items.zh: 屏幕碎了，换个屏得多少钱？
items.scene: 手机摔了，去路边维修店问换屏价格

answers.en: The screen's cracked. How much would a screen replacement cost?
answers.note: cracked 指裂了但没全碎，would 让问价客气，适合正规维修店，语气最稳。

answers.en: How much to replace a cracked screen?
answers.note: 省略主语的问价句，像柜台前简短询价，最省事，但不如上一句客气。

answers.en: My screen shattered. What am I looking at to get it fixed?
answers.note: shattered 指碎得厉害，What am I looking at 是问大概花多少钱的口语说法，带点无奈。

items.zh: 这手机修一下还值吗？还是直接换新的？
items.scene: 旧手机进水，跟朋友商量修还是换

answers.en: Is it even worth fixing, or should I just get a new one?
answers.note: even worth 带怀疑，暗示修理可能不划算，两个选项一起摆出，适合让朋友帮拿主意。

answers.en: Should I repair it or cut my losses and buy a new phone?
answers.note: cut my losses 指及时止损，偏果断，适合手机问题多、修了也不放心时，比上一句坚决。

answers.en: Do you think fixing it makes sense, or is it time to upgrade?
answers.note: makes sense 语气理性，upgrade 把换新说得好听，比直接说 buy a new one 委婉。

items.zh: 你换新手机了？旧的呢？
items.scene: 看到同事拿着新手机，随口问旧机去向

answers.en: You got a new phone? What happened to the old one?
answers.note: 先确认再追问，What happened to 很随口，适合普通同事闲聊，不带预设。

answers.en: New phone? What did you do with the old one?
answers.note: New phone? 名词短句反问，带惊讶，后面问得更直接，适合关系熟的人。

answers.en: Is that a new phone? Did you trade in your old one?
answers.note: trade in 指以旧换新，先猜一个具体去向，适合知道对方爱换数码产品时，比上一句具体。

items.zh: 我想换手机，预算三千，有推荐吗？
items.scene: 在数码店看新机，向店员说明预算

answers.en: I'm looking to get a new phone with a budget of 3,000 yuan. Any recommendations?
answers.note: looking to get 比 want to buy 委婉，先报预算再问推荐，适合店员接待，语气稳。

answers.en: I want to upgrade, but I'm capped at 3,000 yuan. What would you suggest?
answers.note: capped at 强调预算上限，upgrade 指换新机，语气直接，适合想快速看机型的人。

answers.en: I've got 3,000 yuan to spend on a new phone — what do you recommend?
answers.note: I've got...to spend 很口语，像朋友间报预算，适合气氛轻松的数码店，客套最少。

items.zh: 这里怎么一点信号都没有？
items.scene: 地下停车场扫码缴费，手机没网

answers.en: Why is there no signal down here?
answers.note: Why is there 直接问原因，down here 指地下，语气偏抱怨但仍克制。

answers.en: I'm not getting any signal. Is yours working?
answers.note: not getting any signal 是没信号的常用说法，再问对方以排除手机问题，比上一句冷静。

answers.en: There's zero signal in this garage — how am I supposed to pay?
answers.note: zero signal 加重语气，反问句带烦躁，适合赶着出停车场、顾不上客套时。

items.zh: 你那边信号好吗？我这视频一直卡。
items.scene: 跟客户视频会议，画面一直停住

answers.en: Is your signal okay? My video keeps freezing.
answers.note: signal 指网络信号，freezing 指画面卡住，先问对方再说明自己，语气合作。

answers.en: How's your connection? The video keeps stalling on my end.
answers.note: connection 比 signal 稍技术，on my end 明确问题在自己这边，适合正式工作会议。

answers.en: Are you getting a good signal? This video call keeps cutting out for me.
answers.note: getting a good signal 偏口语，cutting out 指声音画面断续，带点着急，比上一句外露。

items.zh: 开个热点给我，我这边没网。
items.scene: 咖啡馆办公，同事电脑连不上 Wi-Fi

answers.en: Can you turn on your hotspot? I don't have internet here.
answers.note: turn on your hotspot 是明确请求，先说自己没网，适合同事之间直接开口。

answers.en: Could you share your hotspot? I can't get online.
answers.note: Could you share 比上一句客气，can't get online 说清困难，适合不太熟或对方是上级。

answers.en: Set up a hotspot for me, would you? I've got no connection.
answers.note: 祈使句加 would you 很随意，带熟人间的理所当然，只适合关系好的同事。

items.zh: 充电宝你带了吗？我手机撑不到回家。
items.scene: 下班路上手机电量见红，问同行朋友

answers.en: Did you bring a power bank? My phone won't make it home.
answers.note: 先问带没带，won't make it home 指电量撑不到家，说法形象，适合朋友同行。

answers.en: Do you have a power bank on you? Mine's about to die.
answers.note: on you 指身上带着，Mine's about to die 口语化，问法省事，比上一句直接。

answers.en: Any chance you have a power bank? I'm running on empty here.
answers.note: Any chance 让请求委婉，running on empty 带自嘲，适合不好意思开口时，客套最多。
